values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Amelia lists 'Primitive Camping' among its recreational opportunities; 'Numerous parking lots exist to access the area, and a concrete boat ramp is available'. The 300-ft setback rules out camping beside Amelia Lake or the boat ramp. Spring turkey season is quota-hunt only on Amelia (opening day and the next 3 weeks), and the two shooting ranges are open September 1 - March 31.
